notes: P02 deterministic dataset builder for GovernanceTrace (DIMVA 2027). generate(seed, split, n) delegates family assignment, split partitioning, leakage discipline and the content hash to the shared kernel dataset_kernel.generate('dimva', ...) (kernel v1.0.0, unit prefix camp-, four registered families benign_session / low_and_slow / cross_tool_obfuscation / burst_probe) and only adds the DIMVA-specific payload enrichment: campaign_length_events, tools_used (synthetic T01-T12 codes), denial_rate and inter_arrival_delay_seconds drawn from per-family operational ranges via pure integer modular arithmetic on the kernel determinant (no random module, no clock, no environment). write_dataset(outdir, seed, n) materializes dataset.jsonl + manifest.json (content_sha256, JSONL byte hash, split and family inventory, both generator versions) and fails closed via assert_valid_frequencies BEFORE creating any file. Real artifact written: research/venue2027/proof/artifacts/dimva_dataset/ (seed=2027, n=120: 72/24/24 train/dev/test, 30 per family, dataset_jsonl_sha256=14fe61ff142e93eceea32619620982c61eb2ea7366a48b50f86dd0c23f6c1c6f). Determinism proven: same seed -> identical JSONL bytes; content hash split-independent per kernel contract. Tests: 22 passed (positive: kernel delegation identity, determinism, split disjointness via assert_no_leakage, camp- unit prefix, operational-field bounds, family-regime separation, JSON-serializability + PHI-free keys, balanced frequencies, write_dataset manifest/idempotency; adversarial: n=0/-5 -> INVALID_N, unknown split -> UNKNOWN_SPLIT, duplicate-unit leakage -> SPLIT_LEAKAGE, degenerate families -> INVALID_FAMILY_FREQUENCY with no directory created, unknown family enrichment -> UNKNOWN_DIMVA_FAMILY, kernel registry drift guard, cross-venue unit-id collision guard). Shared foundations + dimva regression: 216 passed. ruff@0.7.1 check + format clean. source_sha_after = base SHA per established repo convention (proof report committed together with the work in the single task commit).
